title: Oven Roasted Uruguayan Cheddar Bake
description: A rich and creamy Uruguayan dish featuring mature cheddar cheese, this bake is perfect for a romantic dinner, and is sugar free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large paella pan, combine the diced onion and bell pepper and cook over medium heat until the vegetables are tender.
Add the diced ham to the pan and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the shredded cheddar cheese to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Pour the egg mixture over the ham and vegetables in the paella pan.
Transfer the paella pan to the preheated oven and bake for 35 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the cheese is melted and golden brown.
Remove the pan from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the bake hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
